ai_language_tip: Speak polite Standard Bengali (Cholito/Promito, bn) with 'apni'; Dhaka/Chattogram/Sylheti dialect speakers all understand standard Bengali; switch to English only at upmarket hotels, hospitals and chain restaurants in Dhaka (Gulshan/Banani) if staff offers.
english_ok: sometimes — Fine at international hotels, large private hospitals and corporate offices in Dhaka; rare at local shops, chambers, couriers and outside big cities.
politeness: Use 'apni' and a respectful greeting ('Assalamu alaikum', or 'Nomoshkar' with Hindu owners); address men as 'bhai' and women as 'apa' informally; state you are calling on behalf of someone; end with 'dhonnobad'.
name_tip: Bengali names vary a lot and many people use a nickname (daak naam); give the full name as it should appear on the booking and the patient's age for doctor serials; spell English letters if the shop writes it in English.
phone_tip: Mobile 017 1234 5678 style (11 digits starting 01, +880 drops the 0); landlines are rarely used by small businesses; WhatsApp/IMO on the same mobile is common; SMS confirmations for serials and couriers.
time_tip: CRITICAL: 'সাড়ে সাতটা' = 7:30, 'সোয়া সাতটা' = 7:15, 'পৌনে আটটা' = 7:45, 'দেড়টা' = 1:30, 'আড়াইটা' = 2:30; no AM/PM, so day-part words (সকাল/দুপুর/বিকাল/সন্ধ্যা/রাত) decide it; always read back with the day part.
number_tip: Bengali digits (০–৯) appear in writing; 'দেড়' = 1.5 and 'আড়াই' = 2.5 (also for money and hours); read phone numbers in short groups (017-1234-5678 style).
avoid_calling: Avoid Friday Jumma prayer time (about 12:30–14:30), Ramadan iftar time (sunset) and the hour after, restaurant peaks 13:30–15:00 and 20:30–22:30, and calls after 22:00; doctor chambers are reachable mostly in the afternoon/evening before chamber hours.
closed_days: Government offices and banks close Friday and Saturday (Sunday–Thursday working week); most private shops and restaurants open on Saturday; Dhaka markets each close one fixed day a week by zone (e.g. some areas Tuesday, others Sunday or Thursday) with a half day before or after; Eid-ul-Fitr and Eid-ul-Adha bring multi-day closures; Pohela Boishakh (14 April) and other national days are holidays.
booking_channels: Doctor serials by phone to the chamber assistant or via Doctor Talika (the platform phones the chamber and confirms the serial), Sasthya Seba and DocTime (telemedicine); food via foodpanda and Pathao Food; rides via Pathao, Uber and inDrive; shopping on Daraz and Facebook pages with cash on delivery; payment by bKash/Nagad.
voice_menu: Telecoms (Grameenphone, Robi, Banglalink), banks, bKash and airlines use IVR in Bengali/English; doctor chambers, shops and restaurants are answered by a person (often an assistant).
callback_habits: Small shops and Facebook-page businesses often call back from a personal mobile or reply on WhatsApp/IMO/Messenger; doctor serial lines confirm a serial number by phone or SMS; couriers phone shortly before delivery.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 遊樂園、室內遊戲場與觀光船多為現場買票，團體場地（如社區中心、度假村）較常電話訂；週五與節日人潮最多。

may_come_up.what: Says tickets are sold only at the gate
Asks for a bKash advance to reserve a group slot

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to send full payment to a personal bKash number before any confirmation

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 美容院（parlour）與理髮店常可電話或 Facebook 粉專訊息預約；新娘妝與節慶前（Eid、婚禮季）需提早並可能收訂金。

may_come_up.what: Bridal or Eid packages need an advance payment
Walk-in only for simple haircuts

sensitive_asked.what: Requests advance via a personal mobile wallet to an unverified number

usually_asked: Service (haircut, facial, threading, bridal makeup, mehndi)

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消多半直接打給原店家或醫師助理；醫師序號（serial）通常無法轉讓，改日要重新排號。

may_come_up.what: New serial only for a later day
Advance payment not refundable

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the transaction ID of the original bKash payment

usually_asked: Name and phone used for the booking
Original date, time or serial number

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 醫師多在私人診間（chamber）晚間看診，須先打給助理拿序號（serial）；熱門專科可能要提早幾天，也可用 Doctor Talika 等平台代約。

may_come_up.what: Assistant gives a serial number and approximate time
Doctor is fully booked; offers another chamber or day

sensitive_asked.what: Asks details of symptoms or previous reports in depth

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行、bKash/Nagad 與電力公司客服有語音選單並須本人核身，代理人通常只能問一般資訊。

may_come_up.what: Only the account holder can be served

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NID number, PIN, OTP or account number

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 國民身分證（NID）、護照與許多公共服務改走線上申請與現場辦理；學校招生多看公告，電話主要問時間與文件；辦證建議改走線上入口或親臨辦事處。

may_come_up.what: Directs to online portal or office visit

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NID or birth registration number

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電、冷氣維修與搬家多靠電話或 Facebook 找師傅，地址須含門牌、路號、區名與地標；樓層與有無電梯會影響報價。

may_come_up.what: Quotes only after visiting
Visiting charge applies even without repair

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full payment in advance to a personal wallet

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 達卡與 Cox's Bazar 等觀光地飯店電話訂房普遍，旺季（冬季、節日）常要求預付訂金；國際連鎖飯店多走官網。

may_come_up.what: Advance payment required to confirm
Asks NID or passport at check-in

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card details or a copy of NID/passport over the phone

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 詢問營業時間、價格或有無貨，電話與 Facebook 訊息皆常見，店家多直接口頭回答。

may_come_up.what: Gives price or hours directly

pet.before_dialing_zh: 寵物診所與美容主要在達卡，多可電話預約；預約時會問動物種類與年齡。

may_come_up.what: Vaccination record needed

sensitive_asked.what: Asks payment details for home visit

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋常見牆上「To-let」告示直接打電話，或用 Bproperty 等平台；房東常問家庭人數與職業。

may_come_up.what: Owner asks family size and occupation

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NID copy or workplace details

repair.before_dialing_zh: 手機、電器與汽車維修多為走入店面，電話常用來問價格與零件；摩托車與汽車修理廠可電話約時間。

may_come_up.what: Price only after inspection
Parts must be ordered

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to pay for parts in advance to a personal number

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 一般餐廳多為現場候位，高級或連鎖餐廳可電話訂位；齋戒月（Ramadan）開齋時段（iftar）非常熱門須提早訂。

may_come_up.what: No reservations, walk-in only
Iftar buffet needs advance payment
Minimum order for large groups

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full prepayment to a personal mobile wallet for a small table

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 許多小店與 Facebook 商家接受電話或訊息訂貨，常用貨到付款（cash on delivery）；蛋糕與甜點店需提前預訂。

may_come_up.what: Advance payment needed for custom cake

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full payment to an unknown number before delivery

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 外帶與外送多用 foodpanda / Pathao Food，小餐館也接受電話訂餐自取（parcel）；尖峰時段電話常忙線。

may_come_up.what: Asks to order via foodpanda instead
Delivery charge outside area

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to share an app account OTP

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 快遞（Pathao Courier、Steadfast、Sundarban 等）與 Daraz 查件多以追蹤碼在網站或熱線處理，電話客服常塞線；建議改用官網追蹤或 App 內訊息。

may_come_up.what: Gives status from the tracking ID

transport.before_dialing_zh: 市內叫車多用 Pathao、Uber 或 inDrive App；包車、機場接送與長途巴士（以及跨城租車含司機）可電話預訂。

may_come_up.what: Rental car price includes or excludes fuel and tolls
Bus seats sold by counter or online

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NID for a car rental
